svg.text: Experimental KRLY BLE read + PC Mode
0079:181C back to XInput for full PC Mode.
Controller Choice works offline: PC Mode configures every listed pad on this PC without writing to unverified flash.
X10 Bluetooth read-back was adapted from EasyGamepad and still awaits a physical X10 hardware check.
